# flush

common

open suspend fun [flush](flush.html)(key: [SessionKey](../-session-key/index.html)? = null)

Waits until the writes appended before this call are persisted: those to [key](flush.html), or to every session when [key](flush.html) is `null`. Canceling the caller stops the wait, not the writes.

The default does nothing, which suits a service that persists each write before returning; a service that buffers writes overrides it, and a service that wraps another passes it on.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The session to flush, or `null` for every session. A non-null key needs a non-null [SessionKey.id](../-session-key/id.html).

#### Throws

[SessionException](../-session-exception/index.html)

if a buffered write could not be persisted.
